title: [BUG]Incorrect gradient computation in ZeRO-2 with DeepSpeed ≥ 0.17.6
author: wxhcore

comments.author: tohtana
wxhcore
comments.body:
Thank you for your advice!
I have pulled the latest code from the `master` branch and conducted tests using DeepSpeed version `0.18.3+6eb98aaf` with ZeRO-2.  The test results are as follows:

```
step: 1/96 | loss: 1.4401 | lr: 5.56e-06 | grad_norm: 4.7373 | epoch: 0.03
step: 2/96 | loss: 1.3686 | lr: 1.11e-05 | grad_norm: 3.9810 | epoch: 0.06
step: 3/96 | loss: 1.7664 | lr: 1.67e-05 | grad_norm: 6.0319 | epoch: 0.09
step: 4/96 | loss: 1.8631 | lr: 2.22e-05 | grad_norm: 3.9356 | epoch: 0.12
```

As can be seen, the results on the current `master` branch are **entirely consistent** with the training behavior of ZeRO-2 under earlier DeepSpeed versions (< 0.17.6).  This indicates that the issue has been fixed in `master`.

We look forward to the official patch release containing this fix as soon as possible!

comments.author: tohtana
comments.body: Hi @wxhcore, we just released v0.18.3 including the fix.
